div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 餐廳已收貨，店員當面核對下單本人

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 記錄原因，待酒商取回；服務未完成

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 同裝置進入客人專用畫面，顯示酒款、數量與費用

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 簽名失效，待酒商取回；服務費不退、平台付退運

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 填下單人姓名、手寫簽名並保存明細快照

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 簽名非空白且明細相符？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 顯示錯誤，清除或重新核對簽名

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 原子保存付款、分潤與服務完成；可協助開酒

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 待付款，保留有效簽名，不可開酒

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 交回店員，餐廳核對金額與付款責任

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 原子保存餐廳代收、應付款、分潤與服務完成；可開酒

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人稍後併餐費結帳；餐廳負責向酒商付款
